newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Pricing speculation pulls Richter lower.
newsitem.headline: Pricing speculation pulls Richter lower.

text.p: Shares in Hungarian pharmaceuticals company Richter Gedeon Rt fell 1.5 percent in early trading on the Budapest Stock Exchange on Thursday amid speculation over its issue price.
The pricing procedure in the second phase of Richter's privatisation is expected to take place later on Thursday and the market was expecting a discount from the market price.

"The market was expecting a discount of between five to 10 percent, a price of around 13,000 or 13,500 forints," one trader said. "This is the reason behind the fact that certain speculators began to unload the paper."
At 1013 GMT Richter traded at 14,250 forints, down 205 forints from Wednesday's close of 14,455. Until this time less than 4,000 Richter shares have changed hands.
But market participants said other investors were buying the paper.
"They're not in a hurry to buy but keep on buying," the trader said, adding he did not expect the stocks to fall too much more on Thursday.
